== Course of events ==

Having passed through the Black Pit and the Valley of Voe, the Wizard reached the realm of the Mangaboos by balloon. There he encountered the Sorcerer, Gwig, a thorny figure who met him with a contest of magic. The Wizard prevailed over the Sorcerer in this contest, matching and overcoming Gwig's magical arts.

In the course of this confrontation, the Wizard also learned a singular fact about the Mangaboos: unlike other peoples, they are not born, but grow from bushes.
